centre.name: Turning Point Recovery Society
centre.address: 455 W 13th Ave #445, Vancouver, BC V5Y 1W4, Canada

about_blocks.text: Addiction is a serious disease that does not discriminate. It ruins families, communities and the economy by placing an unsustainable burden on the healthcare system, losing productivity costs due to absenteeism, disability and premature death. Turning Point Recovery Society is a non-profit organization based in BC that provides addiction recovery services.
about_blocks.html: Addiction is a serious disease that does not discriminate. It ruins families, communities and the economy by placing an unsustainable burden on the healthcare system, losing productivity costs due to absenteeism, disability and premature death. Turning Point Recovery Society is a non-profit organization based in BC that provides addiction recovery services.

about_blocks.text: The organization offers a cost-effective alternative to more expensive private programs in the Lower Mainland and throughout the province. It boasts of having a proven track record of over 30 years in the Lower Mainland. Turning Point is one of only five facilities licensed under the BC Community Care Assisted Living Act, which strictly monitors all aspects of its operations. Additionally, Turning Point was the first provider in BC to be accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF). The Richmond and Vancouver sites are conveniently located to public transit and other support services.

about_blocks.text: Turning Point provides individual and personalized care, which proves effective for clients. The smaller facilities allow for more personalized care and client attention. The organization believes that every individual is responsible for their life and decisions or can learn to be responsible. Their services are client-centered based on evidence-based best-and emerging practice models. The clients complete Individual Service Plans tailored to meet their unique needs. There is also follow-up and continuing care planning, reintegration and a return to work programs.

about_blocks.text: Turning Point Recovery Society is a non-profit organization devoted to helping individuals struggling with addiction, along with their families and communities. With the rise of addiction becoming one of the most critical issues in society, Turning Point offers a continuum of residential and outpatient support services, education, and leadership opportunities to help combat the problem. The organization operates with the concern that addiction causes an immense amount of suffering to families and communities, from lost productivity, disability, death, and the economic costs that weigh heavily on the already over-burdened health care, justice systems, and overall economy.

about_blocks.text: The mission of Turning Point is to provide safe, supportive housing for vulnerable citizens, including facilitated entrance into community-based addictions support networks. Turning Point further assists individuals in regaining independence, reaching maximum potential, and becoming active members of society. By doing so, Turning Point aims to reduce the social and economic costs of substance abuse within the community and the province of British Columbia. With dedication and commitment, Turning Point aims to make a difference in the lives of those affected by addiction and the surrounding society.

faqs.question: What services does Turning Point offer?

answer_blocks.text: Turning Point Recovery Society offers residential addictions support recovery, which provides individual and personalized care, follow-up and continuing care planning as well as reintegration and return to work programs.
answer_blocks.html: Turning Point Recovery Society offers residential addictions support recovery, which provides individual and personalized care, follow-up and continuing care planning as well as reintegration and return to work programs.

faqs.question: Who can apply for Turning Point Recovery Society's services?

answer_blocks.text: Anyone seeking help with addiction can apply for Turning Point’s services.
answer_blocks.html: Anyone seeking help with addiction can apply for Turning Point’s services.

faqs.question: What addiction treatments does Turning Point offer?

answer_blocks.text: Turning Point offers evidence-based best-and emerging practice models of addiction treatment.

faqs.question: What does the application process involve?

answer_blocks.text: Interested individuals need to fill out an application form, undergo an interview, and provide information about their addiction and medical history.
